chapter: Kansas City, Basie, Prez and Booker Pittman
title: Meeting Count Basie at the Eblon Theater
summary: Budd jams in the pit with Basie, who plays for silent pictures at the Eblon.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: So in other words, then after -- during that time is when I first met Count Basie. And Count Basie was playing piano for silent pictures.
What meeting was that -- what year was that, Budd?
This was like 1928, coming into like, '29. And the Count was playing organ at the Eblon Theater in Kansas City, Missouri for silent pictures.
What's the name of that theater again?
That's a black theater, of course.

A black theater. It's right off of 18th and Vine. So I used to go down -- first I would go pick up a pint of weedled Whiskey that I would get on the north side of Chicago, called Little Italy, where all of the gangsters were, and buy that weedled Whiskey, and I'd get me a pint and I would come down and sit in the pit with Basie with my horn, and jam with him.
Then all of a sudden he'd say, "Now wait a minute, I've got to play a love scene." And I would have to stop play-
ing and he would go into his love scene, then after the love scene then we would just play, just play, just jam and play anything we wanted to play, you know?
